column1: # What the differential test compares, and where each file came from.
# Columns: role, source (commit:path, or the path in this repo), sha256 of the bytes.
# The rolling dev pre-release, e4b385b (tagged dev, and v0.1.0 locally), is the only published
# build: no v* tag was pushed or released. Its StaticTracker read Painscreek_Data\Managed\HeadTracking.cfg
# through cameraunlock-core's HeadTrackingConfigData.LoadFromFile over ConfigParsingUtils, at the
# pin it recorded, 34656598. The oracle compiles both core files byte for byte. They also use
# IHeadTrackingConfig, SensitivitySettings, MathUtils.Clamp01, SmoothingUtils.DefaultLocalSmoothing
# and DefaultRemoteSmoothing and OpenTrackReceiver.DefaultPort, taken from the current core: the
# first three files are unchanged since 34656598, and the constants hold 0.0, 0.15 and 4242 at both.
# The startup half of the oracle is the body of StaticTracker.ParseKeyCode at e4b385b, with its
# Log call writing to the run's list.
